thread:
sam: heads up, int4 bring-up shows a sharp regression on our multi-turn clarification promptset. lots of truncations.
maya: which model? how big is the drop?
sam: q4b-int4-v2. quick eval vs fp16: answer_completeness fp16=0.92 int4=0.48 on 420 cases. failures = mid-sentence stops.
anita: yikes. can you paste 3 example pairs inline?
sam: example 1:\n fp16: '...and then call the API with the header set to authorization: Bearer...'
 int4: '...and then call the API with the header'
example 2:\n fp16: long step-by-step explanation preserved
 int4: stops after first clause
example 3:\n fp16: full clarification including follow-up prompt
 int4: missing follow-up, ends abruptly
logan: any kernel or kv-cache changes in the quant path recently?
sam: infra said no tokenizer change. there was a tiny seq-padding tweak in quant kernels last deploy.
ci-bot: smoke CI: no OOMs, p95 latency +18ms on longctx int4 workers.
olivia: labeling-bot, create a 100-sample microgolden from that failing subset and route to golden cohort.
labeling-bot: created microgolden 100/420 -> assigned to "golden-ops". ETA 7-9h.
maya: while labels run, sam pls dump paired outputs with token-probs and truncation points so we can verify metric isn't miscounting.
sam: will produce diffs and upload shortly.
anita: actions:\n - sam: paired diffs + 50 examples (ASAP)\n - maya: review metric edge cases for truncation counting (today)\n - olivia: monitor labels, if >30% labels say OK, mark metric bug; else escalate fix for quant kernel\n - logan: file infra ticket about padding/kv-cache mismatch and attach traces (ETA EOD)
maya: if labels confirm quality drop, schedule rollback for affected prod routes (canary to fp16 5%).
sam: posting diffs in ~20m. tagging @logan for infra traces. :thumbsup:
labeling-bot: will update thread at 25/100 and 100/100 label completion.
